{{Top|leg}}
The '''B'omarr pipe nalargon''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument played by the [[Monk/Legends|monks]] of the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]]. Described as an "engine of unfaithful rhapsody," it was commonly believed that none outside the B'omarr Order could tame the instrument. Despite its reputation, the genius [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]] mastered this [[Nalargon/Legends|nalargon]] variant and considered it his favorite.
